issues.where: the main spire, whole face from summit to base
issues.what: the rock is an evenly lit grey CG surface with stretched, smeared texture and almost no snow; -a has dark, storm-shadowed rock with snow packed on ledges and a snowy shoulder at lower left of the spire
issues.fix: darken the face into storm shadow lit mainly by the bolt, add snow on ledges and the lower snowfield, and replace the stretched texture with sharp fractured rock

issues.where: the whole air of the frame
issues.what: no blowing snow or spindrift, no sparks spraying off the strike, no fume at the summit; -a is full of driven snow streaks, orange sparks and a smoke plume from the strike
issues.fix: add wind-driven snow across the frame, a spark burst at the strike point and a pale plume pouring off the summit

issues.where: the far distance below the horizon
issues.what: -a looks down on a sea of cloud with several sharp spires standing out of it receding into haze; -b shows a flat dark plane and two blocky pale rock slabs at mid-distance, so the sense of height and scale is lost
issues.fix: replace the flat ground with a cloud sea below and set several hazed, darker, sharper spires at increasing distance

issues.what: a uniform blurred brown slab with no snow; -a has a defocused snowy ridge with dark rock showing through
issues.fix: cover the near ridge with snow, keep dark rock breaks, keep it defocused

issues.where: the ribbons streaming off the summit
issues.what: stiff, cut-out lavender sheets with jagged hard edges and no glow; -a has thin, translucent, glowing veils with crackling electric threads
issues.fix: make the ribbons thinner, translucent and lit from within, with small electric filaments trailing off them

issues.where: the lightning strike at the summit
issues.what: the bolt meets the rock with no bright burst and lights nothing around it; the rock top does not glow
issues.fix: add a hot white-violet flash at the strike that lights the summit rock and the nearby fume

issues.where: the sunset band on the horizon
issues.what: the orange band is a thin hard stripe cut by grey smoke; in -a it is a soft warm glow under the cloud deck
issues.fix: soften the warm band and let it glow under the cloud base

issues.where: the spire's edges against the sky
issues.what: hard cut-out edges with visible faceted seams and patchy tile repeats (seen in the crops); -a edges sit in atmosphere
issues.fix: remove the seams and tiling and let haze soften the silhouette

issues.what: walls are a smeared, streaked fur-like texture in flat grey-brown; -a has smooth layered rock with ice glaze, wet highlights and warm-cool colour variation
issues.fix: replace with sharp layered rock glazed with ice, with violet highlights from the mouth and warm tones deeper in

issues.where: the icicles at the cave mouth
issues.what: rigid dark cone spikes hanging in lines; -a has clear, glassy, irregular icicles and ice curtains catching the violet light
issues.fix: make the icicles translucent and irregular, lit from the mouth

issues.where: the view out of the cave
issues.what: the snowy valley with a lit spire, footprints and rocks is replaced by a low grey flat-shaded hill with blocky trees and indistinct ribbon shapes; no sense of the storm-lashed peak
issues.fix: restore the snowy slope with the tall spire and its streaming ribbons, footprints and rocks receding into blowing snow

issues.what: a flat, clean grey-white plane with no ice, no wet sheen, no rocks or snow edging; -a has a glossy frozen stream with reflections and snow banks
issues.fix: make the floor a glossy frozen meltwater channel reflecting the mouth light, with snow and stones along its edges

issues.what: the cluster of frost-covered sleeping animals with long claws is reduced to a few flat-lit brown hair mounds; frost, claws and the huddle mass are gone
issues.fix: rebuild the huddle as several frosted shaggy bodies pressed together against the wall, with frost on the fur tips

issues.where: the standing animal and the pack's lighting
issues.what: fur is evenly lit brown with no violet rim light or frost from the mouth; -a rims the coats in cool violet and keeps the interior dimmer
issues.fix: darken the interior and rim the animals in violet light from the cave mouth, with frosted tips

issues.where: air inside and outside the cave
issues.what: almost no blowing snow; -a has driven snow and haze outside the mouth
issues.fix: add wind-blown snow and haze beyond the mouth

issues.what: the cave is bright and evenly lit, losing the dark, cold, sheltered mood of -a
issues.fix: lower interior exposure and let light fall off from the mouth
